changes.comment: BREAKING: `ScoreUnionMergeStrategy.create` now takes `{ identityResolver }` (required; pass the store) and dedupes and scores records by their scope-qualified `(scope, id)` address instead of the bare `id`, so two MTM `turn-<n>` records in different conversations no longer collapse into one. A record whose identity cannot be resolved fails the merge. New `scopedAddressOf(record, resolver)` helper, also used by the ingest orchestrator.
